system_name: Cosmic DNA Implementation with Player Birth Chart Integration
description: 10 Foundational skills with full Cosmic DNA + Player's personal birth chart creates INSANE depth

PLAYER_BIRTH_CHART_SYSTEM.description: At game start, player creates their CHARACTER'S BIRTH CHART - this becomes their cosmic identity forever

step_1_zodiac_selection.choose_from: 12 zodiac signs (Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces)
step_1_zodiac_selection.UI: Beautiful zodiac wheel with constellations, clicking highlights sign

step_2_degree_selection.precision: Each degree lands in different Nakshatra pada (quarter)
step_2_degree_selection.UI: Sliding degree scale with Nakshatra markers glowing as you slide

step_3_ascendant_locking.what_it_determines: Your 1st House placement - defines your entire house structure
step_3_ascendant_locking.cascading_effect: Once 1st House is set, all 12 houses lock into position
step_3_ascendant_locking.example: Ascendant Leo 10° → 1st House = Leo, 2nd = Virgo, 3rd = Libra, etc.

step_4_planetary_positions.generation: Game generates planetary positions based on a 'cosmic seed' tied to your chart
step_4_planetary_positions.randomization: Planets distributed across your 12 houses semi-randomly but balanced
step_4_planetary_positions.locked_forever: These positions are YOUR CHARACTER'S permanent natal chart
step_4_planetary_positions.display: Full chart diagram shows all planets in houses with aspects

what_the_chart_contains.ruling_planet: Planet that rules your Ascendant sign
what_the_chart_contains.moon_sign: Where Moon is placed in your chart
what_the_chart_contains.all_9_planets: Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu positions
what_the_chart_contains.house_placements: Which planets sit in which houses (1st-12th)
what_the_chart_contains.yogas_in_chart: Natural yogas formed by planetary positions
what_the_chart_contains.strengths: Which planets are strong in your chart
what_the_chart_contains.weaknesses: Which planets are debilitated or weak

how_it_affects_gameplay.skill_affinity: Skills ruled by YOUR strong planets get permanent bonuses
how_it_affects_gameplay.house_bonuses: Skills cast in houses with YOUR planets get huge bonuses
how_it_affects_gameplay.natural_yogas: Some Yogas are EASIER for you based on chart
how_it_affects_gameplay.playstyle_influence: Chart naturally pushes you toward certain strategies

example_leo_ascendant.sun_ruled: All Sun-ruled skills (leadership, glory, command) get +20% permanently
example_leo_ascendant.5th_house_strong: If Sun in 5th House → ALL creation/summoning skills buffed
example_leo_ascendant.magha_nakshatra: Authority-based skills have special effects for you
example_leo_ascendant.fire_element: Fire skills feel 'natural', Water skills require more effort

SKILL_CARD_AS_MINI_CHART.description: Every skill card IS a birth chart showing cosmic relationships

card_layout.outer_ring: 12-house wheel showing where skill is strongest
card_layout.current_power_meter: Real-time calculation based on cosmic weather + YOUR chart

interactive_card.hover_houses: Hover over house sections → see bonus percentages
interactive_card.click_planet: Click planet icon → see full influence explanation
interactive_card.tap_nakshatra: Tap Nakshatra → see when it's active next
interactive_card.compare_to_chart: Button: 'How does this match MY chart?' → shows synergy

synergy_visualization.green_glow: Skill's ruling planet matches YOUR strong planet
synergy_visualization.golden_glow: Skill's house matches YOUR planetary placement
synergy_visualization.rainbow_glow: PERFECT SYNERGY - skill was made for your chart
synergy_visualization.dim_effect: Skill conflicts with your chart (harder to use but still works)

10_FOUNDATIONAL_SKILLS_WITH_FULL_COSMIC_.description: Each skill fully defined with all cosmic properties + interaction with player charts

SKILL_01_SHIELD_PROJECTION.base_effect: Grant 20 shields to target ally for 3 turns

ruling_planet.why: Moon = protection, nurturing, emotional safety, maternal care

jupiter.effect: Shields last +2 turns when Jupiter strong

venus.effect: Shields grant +10 HP healing on cast

mercury.effect: Shields gain +5 per enemy targeting ally

sun.conflict: Harsh solar energy burns away soft shields
sun.effect: Shields last -1 turn during Sun Dasha

primary_house.bonus: +50% shields, +30% duration, shields also protect structures in zone
primary_house.flavor: Cast in the house of home, shields become unbreakable walls

secondary_house.bonus: +20% shields, grants Regen 5 HP/turn to shielded ally

tertiary_house.bonus: Shields absorb 100% damage for 1 turn then disappear
tertiary_house.flavor: Total sacrifice for one perfect moment

perfect_nakshatra.name: Rohini (Moon's favorite mansion)
perfect_nakshatra.special_effect: Shields grant Regen 10 HP/turn, duration +2 turns

excellent_nakshatras.name: Hasta (Skillful hands)
excellent_nakshatras.effect: Can cast shields on 2 allies simultaneously

elemental_nature.water_aspect: Flows around allies, adapts to damage type

combo_potential.earth_plus_water: Shields create 'mud walls' that slow enemies 30%
combo_potential.water_zones: Shields regenerate 5 per turn near water

effects.mental: Grants 'Calm Mind' buff - +10% mental clarity while shielded
effects.team: Other Sattvic skills near shielded ally get +15% effectiveness
effects.duration: Sattvic skills last longer naturally (+20% base duration)

best_dasha.effect: +40% shields, +30% duration, unlock 'Moonshield' - shields reflect 20% damage
best_dasha.strategy: Stack all defensive skills during Moon Dasha for immortal team

good_dasha.effect: +25% shields, shields last until broken (no turn limit)

weak_dasha.strategy: Switch to offensive tactics, use shields only as emergency

moon_exalted.timing: Moon in Taurus (every 27 turns for 2 turns)
moon_exalted.effect: +50% shields, unlock 'Exalted Protection' - shields grant immunity to 1 hit

moon_debilitated.effect: -30% shields, shields break on critical hits

jupiter_conjunction_moon.effect: Shields grant +50 HP healing over duration, shields spread to adjacent allies

mars_opposition_moon.effect: Shields grant 'Rage on Break' - when shield breaks, ally gains +30% attack for 2 turns

if_player_moon_strong.conditions: Moon in 1st/4th/7th/10th house, Moon exalted in natal chart, Moon Ascendant
if_player_moon_strong.permanent_bonus: +20% shields ALWAYS, -1 KP cost, -1 turn cooldown
if_player_moon_strong.special_unlock: Can cast 'Greater Shield Projection' at 25 KP for 40 shields

if_player_4th_house_occupied.conditions: Player has planet in 4th House (especially Moon/Jupiter)
if_player_4th_house_occupied.effect: Shield Projection in 4th House gets DOUBLE bonus (+100% shields, +60% duration)
if_player_4th_house_occupied.playstyle: You naturally want to cast shields in 4th House every time

if_player_cancer_ascendant.effect: This skill feels 'natural' - animations smoother, sound more pleasant, +10% all bonuses

if_player_rohini_nakshatra.effect: Shield always gets Rohini bonus regardless of current Nakshatra timing
if_player_rohini_nakshatra.broken: You can cast god-tier shields ANY TIME

SKILL_02_BANDWIDTH_DYNAMO.base_effect: Generate +15 Bandwidth per turn for 3 turns from target structure

ruling_planet.why: Mercury = communication, neural speed, information flow, mental energy

moon.effect: Bandwidth overflow converts to Ojas at 3:1 ratio

saturn.effect: -5 Bandwidth per turn, +1 turn to activate

primary_house.bonus: +100% Bandwidth generation, converts to KP at end

secondary_house.bonus: Bandwidth spreads to adjacent structures, creating network effect

perfect_nakshatra.name: Ashwini (Swift action)
perfect_nakshatra.special_effect: Generate all 3 turns of Bandwidth INSTANTLY (45 Bandwidth burst)

effects.speed: Bandwidth generates at start of turn (not end)
effects.momentum: Each turn generates +2 more than last (15→17→19)

if_player_mercury_strong.special_unlock: Can cast 'Bandwidth Overload' - 100 Bandwidth instant burst for 50 KP

if_player_gemini_virgo_ascendant.effect: Mercury-ruled signs get this as 'starter skill' with +1 free upgrade

SKILL_03_FOUNDATION_STONE.base_effect: Place indestructible 5×5 structure zone that lasts entire match

ruling_planet.why: Saturn = permanence, foundation, karma, time, endurance
ruling_planet.bonus_when_saturn_strong: Structure becomes 7×7, grants +10 KP per turn passively

mars.effect: Structure has defensive turrets that attack enemies in range

jupiter.effect: Structure zone slowly expands (1 tile per 5 turns)

mercury.effect: Structure takes 2 turns to fully solidify

primary_house.bonus: Structure CANNOT be destroyed even by Yoga-level effects, grants +50% all bonuses

secondary_house.bonus: Structure grants victory points over time (passive win condition)

perfect_nakshatra.name: Uttara Bhadrapada (Cosmic foundation)
perfect_nakshatra.special_effect: Structure exists in ALL matches forever (account-wide permanent structure)

effects.immovable: Structure cannot be moved or displaced

best_dasha.effect: Can place 3 Foundation Stones, each grants +15 KP per turn
best_dasha.strategy: Economy engine that wins through inevitability

if_player_saturn_strong.permanent_bonus: Foundation Stone costs 30 KP instead of 40, cooldown becomes 'twice per match'
if_player_saturn_strong.playstyle: You're the architect who builds unbreakable empires

if_player_capricorn_aquarius_ascendant.effect: Saturn-ruled signs start with Foundation Stone already unlocked

SKILL_04_CONTROLLED_DEMOLITION.base_effect: Destroy target friendly structure, gain 3× its resource value

sun.effect: Demolished structures leave 'blessed ashes' that buff next structure placed

venus.effect: Cannot demolish structures with allies inside

primary_house.bonus: Demolished structures trigger 'Rebirth Protocol' - auto-rebuild at +100% stats in 2 turns
primary_house.flavor: Death is not the end, but transformation

secondary_house.bonus: Sacrifice grants spiritual power - +50 Sanctity (Invocation resource)

perfect_nakshatra.name: Mula (Root destruction)
perfect_nakshatra.special_effect: Can demolish ENEMY structures, gain 5× their value

effects.momentum: Each demolition makes next demolition cheaper (4→3→2→1 KP)

best_dasha.effect: Controlled Demolition costs 0 KP, triggers automatically on low-HP structures

if_player_mars_strong.permanent_bonus: Demolitions grant rage stacks (+5% damage per stack)
if_player_mars_strong.playstyle: Aggressive controller who sacrifices for power spikes

if_player_8th_house_occupied.effect: Transformation is your THEME - all sacrifice skills +30% effectiveness

SKILL_05_TEMPORAL_ANCHOR.base_effect: Lock target structure in time - cannot be destroyed or moved for 5 turns

mars.effect: Duration -2 turns, high damage can break anchor

primary_house.bonus: Anchored structure exists in 'timeless space' - immune to ALL effects (good and bad)

secondary_house.bonus: Anchor preserves structure even through death - resurrects if destroyed

perfect_nakshatra.name: Uttara Ashadha (Eternal victory)
perfect_nakshatra.special_effect: Temporal Anchor becomes permanent - structure locked forever

effects.frozen: Time literally stops for anchored structure

best_dasha.effect: All structures auto-anchor when placed, 0 KP cost

if_player_saturn_dominant.permanent_bonus: Temporal Anchor lasts 10 turns instead of 5 ALWAYS
